Rudan Tile, modular steel roof panels is an innovative and unique new metal roofing product. The tiles are made of premium G90 steel, with matt crinkle look color coating with strong resistance to abrasion and corrosion. Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.

Custom valleys are a beneficial component of many residential roof applications. The center crimp of a Four Seasons custom valley flashing helps relieve stress, providing long-lasting strength at a critical point, while effectively channeling rainwater.
Wall flashings are used as a transition from the existing structure to the roof.Concealing any gaps and diverting water
Chimney flashing protects your roof from water penetration.
Concealed Hip and Inside Gable flashing help divert water from your metal roof.
End Gable flashing provides a barrier against water penetration and a transition between your roof and fascia.

Stellar's custom starters help channel water away from the roof edge, offering protection from leaking and pooling. If rain, snow, or ice are present, the starter ensures that water does not penetrate rafter rails, insulation, fascia, or soffits.
Snow stoppers and ice breakers prevent large ice formation on your roof.

Ridge caps are a key component of a metal roof. They allow for air flow – up to 10 times more than a traditional shingled roof. Our ridge caps are made from the same material as our roofing and cladding products and are manufactured in our facility.
Skylight flashing protects your skylight from water penetration.
